description.en: Creates a new camera object and returns its handle, for scripts that build a camera programmatically instead of loading one from a file (see CMND_LOAD_CAMERA). Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Internal name for the camera instance.

example.code:
// Create a new camera object
local hCamera = CMND_CREATE_CAMERA("eventCam");
